## FLOOWBOX - Research Funding Tracker
Built for MS in AI application prep — Fall 2027.
Runs weekly. 3 parallel Perplexity searches:
- Active research groups at target labs taking students
- Open-source AI projects to contribute to
- Research internship opportunities
GPT-4o creates personalized action plan:
- Which professors to cold email
- Which GitHub repos to contribute to
- Internship deadlines
- This week's specific actions
